<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex06012025-05-1313-25-18" status="unreviewed">bkag pa rnams kyang ri gzig   pas | thugs rje ldan pa de la gnang zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon shan ti ba</rs>s 'don no skad do || 'di la byang chub sems dpa'
               <lb edRef="inst:4477" n="33b3"/> khyim pa la rtsa ba ba hi' char dang rab du byung pa la mi tshegs par spyod pa ma rtogs pa thams cad gnang ngo zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> zer ba ni mi 'thad de | dge' slong lasogs pa 'i rtsa ba bzhi' thams cad du gnas pa'i skabs med par bcas pa'i phyir | bcas pa'i pham pa bzhi' char la 'gyur bas sdom pa nyams su 'gyur ba'i phyir | sdom pa phul la 'jug par bya'o || des na bram
               <lb edRef="inst:4477" n="33b4"/>ze'i khye' bu skar ma lo khe' stong du tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas | gzhan kho na'i don du tshangs spyod gtuang yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa dang || de yon gyi tshong pa g.yon can bsad kyang ngan 'gror ma skyes pa lasogs pa thabs la mkhas pa'i mod lasogs pa nas gsungs so || </seg></TEI>
